charge.description: Requires (X) Half Actions to charge before firing.
charge.hold_charge: May hold charge; may cost extra ammo.

automatic.description: Fires continuously; each shot rolled separately.

burst.description: Single To Hit Test fires multiple shots.
burst.evade_rule: One evasion test negates all shots

flintlock.description: Full Action to fire; long reload time.

pump_action.description: Fires (X) per Half Action; one extra Reaction shot.

semi_auto.description: One shot per trigger pull; accurate.

sustained.description: Continuous damage; one To Hit Test.

drawback.description: Requires (X) Half Actions to draw string.
